segments.name: Net Lease Real Estate Investment Trust
segments.description: Acquires, finances and develops convenience, automotive and other single tenant retail real estate leased on a triple-net basis.
segments.evidence: Getty Realty Corp. ("Getty Realty," "we," "us," "our" and the "Company") (NYSE: GTY), a Maryland corporation, is a publicly traded, net lease real estate investment trust ("REIT") specializing in the acquisition, financing and development of convenience, automotive and other single tenant retail real estate.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rent under long-term triple-net leases where tenants pay property taxes, maintenance, repairs, insurance and operating expenses.
revenueModel.evidence: Substantially all of our properties are leased on a triple-net basis to convenience store operators, petroleum distributors, express tunnel car wash operators, and other automotive-related and retail tenants.
